title: Flo Smart Water Shutoff detected a leak
shortDescription: Continuous or unusual flow triggered the leak alert.
fullDescription:
Flo by Moen continuously monitors flow, pressure and temperature at the main supply. When flow exceeds learned thresholds (running more than 10-30 minutes continuously, or at very low rates consistent with a pinhole), the app raises a leak alert and may close the valve automatically in Home mode.

Inspect fixtures, toilets and irrigation for drips, then use the app to dismiss or schedule a Health Test.

fixSteps.title: Inspect home
fixSteps.instruction: Check toilets for constant fill, faucets for drip, and appliance hoses.

fixSteps.title: Reopen valve
fixSteps.instruction: In Flo app, reopen valve once root cause is resolved.

fixSteps.title: Run Health Test
fixSteps.instruction: Start a Health Test to confirm system is tight.

whenToCallPro: If leak source cannot be located.
videoSearchQuery: Flo by Moen leak alert response

faq.a: Yes in Home mode with AutoShutOff enabled; no in Away mode unless configured.

title: Health Test fails with no flow reading
shortDescription: Flo cannot measure baseline flow during a Health Test.
fullDescription:
Flo Health Tests measure micro-drops in pressure over several minutes. If no flow is detected when any fixture opens, the flow meter may be stuck, the valve may be closed upstream, or the unit has lost prime.

Verify water is on, the Flo valve is open, and fixtures dispense water normally.
symptoms: No flow reading in live view

fixSteps.title: Open valve
fixSteps.instruction: Tap Open in Flo app and verify live flow when turning on a faucet.

whenToCallPro: If flow meter is verifiably failed.
videoSearchQuery: Flo Moen Health Test no flow

faq.q: How often should I run Health Test?
faq.a: Scheduled automatically weekly; run manually after plumbing work.

title: Flo prompts learning mode or recalibration
shortDescription: Household usage pattern has changed significantly and Flo needs to relearn.
fullDescription: After installation Flo spends 1-2 weeks learning your baseline flow. Significant changes (new irrigation system, soft water install, long vacancy) can prompt recalibration. In the app, start a new Learning Mode session to refresh thresholds.

fixSteps.title: Start learning
fixSteps.instruction: In app, go to device settings and restart Learning Mode for 2 weeks.

faq.q: Will it close valves during learning?
faq.a: AutoShutOff is disabled until learning completes.

title: Flo closed the main water valve automatically
shortDescription: AutoShutOff engaged to prevent water damage.
fullDescription:
With AutoShutOff enabled in Home mode, Flo will close the motorized valve when a leak pattern meets the Confident threshold. The home will have no water until the user reopens in the app or at the device.

Review the triggering event in the alert, fix the cause, and reopen via the app or the physical button on the device.

fixSteps.title: Address cause
fixSteps.instruction: Resolve the underlying leak or long-run event.

fixSteps.title: Reopen valve
fixSteps.instruction: Tap Open in Flo app or press the device button.

videoSearchQuery: Flo by Moen auto shutoff reopen

faq.a: Yes, reopen any time from the app or device button.

title: Incoming water pressure exceeds safe threshold
shortDescription: Flo detects pressure above 80 psi which can damage plumbing.
fullDescription:
Flo continuously monitors inlet pressure. Spikes above 80 psi (default alert threshold) commonly indicate a failing or absent pressure-reducing valve. Chronic high pressure stresses hoses, supply lines and appliances.

Install or adjust a PRV to bring static pressure to 60 psi.

fixSteps.title: Confirm pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Use a gauge on an outside hose bib to verify.

fixSteps.title: Adjust or replace PRV
fixSteps.instruction: Plumber adjusts or installs a PRV at the main.

videoSearchQuery: Flo Moen high pressure alert fix

faq.a: Most plumbing codes cap at 80 psi.

title: Flo not reachable by the cloud
shortDescription: Wi-Fi connection to Flo device has been lost.
fullDescription: Flo connects to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Router changes, power outages or signal issues cause offline status. Monitoring continues locally but alerts do not reach the app until reconnected.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug Flo for 60 seconds and reconnect.

fixSteps.title: Re-onboard
fixSteps.instruction: In app, tap Reconnect Wi-Fi and follow steps.

title: Water temperature near freezing
shortDescription: Flo measured supply water temperature dropping near 40 F.
fullDescription: Flo monitors water temperature at the device. If water approaches 40 F (configurable), a freeze-risk alert is raised. In basements or crawl spaces this warns of pending burst-pipe conditions. Add heat tape or increase ambient heat.

fixSteps.title: Warm the space
fixSteps.instruction: Raise thermostat, open cabinet doors, add space heater.

fixSteps.title: Drip faucets
fixSteps.instruction: Open faucets to a pencil-lead stream to prevent freeze.

whenToCallPro: If insulation or heat tape install is needed.

title: Motorized valve did not reach open or closed position
shortDescription: Valve motor stalled or feedback indicates it did not complete travel.
fullDescription:
Flo's built-in motorized ball valve reports its position via feedback. If the motor fails to move to the commanded state (open or closed) within a timeout, a valve fault is reported and the device enters safe state.

Common causes are a seized ball after long periods without movement, debris, or a worn actuator. Schedule monthly valve exercises from the app.

fixSteps.title: Retry in app
fixSteps.instruction: Attempt open/close from app, watch for partial travel.

fixSteps.title: Service call
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Moen or a plumber if valve does not recover.

faq.a: Yes, monthly scheduled open/close helps prevent seizing.
